launches.title: Decent: Your health plan should get better year-round. Not just once a year.
launches.tagline: We find the best health plan for your company, and use AI to make it better all year.
launches.body:
Hi everyone. I'm [Nick Soman](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nicksoman/), cofounder of [Decent](https://www.decent.com/) (F26) with [Andrew Budker](https://www.linkedin.com/in/abudker/).\
\
<https://youtu.be/ICNV6Scchqw>

\
**The problem**\
You choose your company health plan once a year at renewal, and then nobody touches it for twelve months. All year long you overpay without seeing it. A one-time surgery gets built into next year's rates as if it’s recurring. You get billed for employees who left months ago. Your team uses the ER for things that primary care could have handled for a fraction of the cost.\
\
I learned this the hard way. A carrier raised my old company's rates 27% in January because an employee had started an expensive treatment the February before. They told me it was my data and my fault for not looking. Almost all of that cost was waste. She could have been treated at home for 30% less. An equally effective treatment that cost 25% less could have been free to her. Optimized dosing could have saved 20% more, with fewer side effects and no negative impact on her health.\
\
**How Decent is different**\
Your health plan should get better all year, not once a year. You don't buy a year of ads or a rack of servers up front anymore, but health insurance is stuck on a single annual renewal. Decent is an AI-native health insurance broker for US companies with 2 to 200 employees. We compare every way to cover your team, show what each one costs, and then keep improving your plan all year, for your company and for your employees. The insurance company you choose pays us, so we’re free to you.\
\
**Why trust us**\
Andrew and I met 16 years ago building the Kindle at Amazon. He spent the last several years leading engineering for Metamate, Meta's internal AI platform. I've started and sold two companies and raised $42M. Before this I built and ran level-funded plans, PEOs, and association health plans, with a Net Promoter Score of 79 vs. the industry average of 14, so I know what good looks like and where the system breaks. \
\
The full story of why I came back to this, and why it's called Decent, is here: <https://www.decent.com/blog/run-it-back>\
\
**Traction**\
AI is doing 89% of our brokerage work and climbing, and we just caught a one-time surgery driving 46% of a client's claims spend and kept it out of next year's rates. 67 companies are working with us so far, and many more are close behind.\
\
**What you can do now**

* If you or someone you know runs or helps run a US company with roughly 2 to 200 people renewing by January 1, 2027, book 15 minutes with me to find the best plan for you: <https://meetings-na2.hubspot.com/nick-soman/15-yc> 
* Want to look first? [Get a quote](https://www.decent.com/quote) and price the market yourself on our site, no call needed.
* Know a company that's overpaying? Introduce us and we'll pay you when they get a quote, whether or not they buy: [decent.com/refer](http://decent.com/refer)

Our mission: affordable healthcare for all. It's never too late to save the world.\
\
Nick & Andrew
